title: Locate the two CH-0236 candidate record spans
changes: Document that the imported CH-0236 halfwords target different candidate records and relate the anomalous first pair to the analogous candidate ability-progress span.
validation: Protected static check compared unchanged source lines and decoder width with retained USA record boundaries and the previous first-record progress span. The first halfword falls at second-record offsets BC..BD; the second falls at third-record offsets 06..07 (dbg20-ch0236-spans-53ly10yn). No guest execution was performed.
limitations: The candidate progress span length is EUR-derived; second-record field semantics, original author intent, actual code/device behavior and valid character combinations are unverified. CH-0236 remains unchanged and excluded from the character projections.
